summary: YPF S.A. filed a US Form 6-K carrying an Argentine relevant-information notice dated October 8, 2026, disclosing open-market repurchases of its Class XXVII Notes (YMCTO) between October 5 and October 7, 2026. The company bought Ps. 22,598,512,039.79 face-equivalent to US$14.85 million par, at an average price of 99.98% of nominal, to be held in portfolio. The notes were issued in October 2023 (US$127.9 million nominal) under the Frequent Issuer framework and mature October 2026. Mechanics are an issuer buyback of near-dated paper; watch residual float, monthly repurchase cadence and any extension/refinancing of the October maturity.
